_comment: Summary of the CAN, timing and display settings in the shared 'iC-7 dash config with
VRacer timing' map (firmware 2.35.1). Decoded with scripts/inspect-nexmap.py and
named with fw/ic7_2360.hdef (every setting id in the map exists in 2.36). The raw map,
its metadata (serial number, profile name) and its images are deliberately not kept.

frames_decoded_by_dash_v2_36.byte_order: big-endian, 11-bit IDs, Haltech CAN bus only

channel_display.best_lap_time_delta: unit Time - formatted (ms), 3 dp, range -10000..10000 ms

gauges: Bar Horizontal Continuous: Best Lap Time Delta (top left, needle reversed)
Bar Horizontal Continuous: Best Lap Time Delta (top right)
Numerics: RPM, Vehicle Speed, Coolant/Fuel/Oil Temperature, Manifold Pressure, Throttle, EGT 1, Coolant Pressure, Battery
Indicators: high beam, right indicator, traction, launch, nitrous, check engine, oil, battery

screens.other_screens: engine screens using native Haltech ECU channels (the map was made for a Haltech ECU)

alarms: 3 enabled (RPM overrev, boost, coolant) on native ECU channels; none uses timing data
